dialogues.jp:
なんだか教室が浮ついていると思ったら、どう
やら今日、どこぞのクラスに転校生が来るらし
い。
dialogues.en:
The class was bubbling with excitement today. Apparently
there was another transfer student in the neighbouring
class.
dialogues.text:
The class was bubbling with excitement today. Apparently
there was another transfer student in the neighbouring
class.

dialogues.jp:
ま、女の子らしいのだが、うちのクラスではな
いようなので話に参加せず、大人しく机の上で
まどろんでいた。
dialogues.en:
Apparently, it's a girl, and she has some strange reasons
for transferring here, from what I heard chattering around
my desk.
dialogues.text:
Apparently, it's a girl, and she has some strange reasons
for transferring here, from what I heard chattering around
my desk.

dialogues.jp:
転校生と恋に落ちるような、そんな展開普通は
ありえないし……。
dialogues.en:
I can't really believe that this transfer student would
transfer to a different school out of an unrequited love...
dialogues.text:
I can't really believe that this transfer student would
transfer to a different school out of an unrequited love...

dialogues.jp:
と、暦先生が教室に入ってくると、浮ついた空
気を払うように出席簿で机をバンバンと叩く。
dialogues.en:
With Koyomi-sensei's entrance into the classroom, the bustle
of the classroom died quickly as the attendance was marked.
dialogues.text:
With Koyomi-sensei's entrance into the classroom, the bustle
of the classroom died quickly as the attendance was marked.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「今週は試験があるからね。ちゃんと今のうち
　から勉強しておいた方が身のためだよ」
dialogues.en:
"This week is examination week, so make sure you study hard
for it."
dialogues.text:
"This week is examination week, so make sure you study hard
for it."

dialogues.jp:
実に暦先生らしい言い方で、朝の連絡が行われ
る。
dialogues.en:
Koyomi-sensei's "words of encouragement" certainly didn't
sound like them.
dialogues.text:
Koyomi-sensei's "words of encouragement" certainly didn't
sound like them.

dialogues.en: More like a threat to the students.
dialogues.text: More like a threat to the students.

dialogues.jp:
暦先生は必要なことだけを言って、とてもあっ
さりと｛ホームルーム／ＨＲ｝を終わらせる。
dialogues.en:
Koyomi-sensei went through the usual things, and then ended
homeroom.
dialogues.text:
Koyomi-sensei went through the usual things, and then ended
homeroom.

dialogues.jp:
今日、どこぞのクラスに転校生が来るとかで、
一部で盛り上がっている。
dialogues.en:
Today, a transfer student came into the other class, and
caused some excitement in this one.
dialogues.text:
Today, a transfer student came into the other class, and
caused some excitement in this one.

dialogues.jp:
転校生との劇的な恋……なんてものを夢見るほ
ど子供じゃない俺は、どっちかと言えば、週末
の試験の方が気になるのだった。
dialogues.en:
The transfer student's dramatic love... sounds more like a
kid's dream, and the subject was quickly changed to worrying
about the coming exams.
dialogues.text:
The transfer student's dramatic love... sounds more like a
kid's dream, and the subject was quickly changed to worrying
about the coming exams.
